chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Muhammad ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from a man, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, concerning a woman who sees blood:
He said: “If her period is less than ten days, she waits until ten days. But if her days are ten, she does not exercise precaution by adding extra days.”

key_terms.الْعَشَرَةِ: ten days, the legal limit mentioned here
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman under discussion in the legal ruling
key_terms.تَسْتَظْهِرْ: to take precaution by extending the waiting period

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a woman who sees blood if her usual period is less than ten days or exactly ten days?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman who sees blood and how she should determine the duration relevant to her state. It distinguishes between one whose cycle is less than ten days and one whose days are ten, clarifying when waiting applies and when precautionary extension does not.
